requested_outcomes: explain why ABS certification stayed PENDING
fix missing docsreg_learning.jsonl entry for attempted cycle
actual_outcomes: learning entry was not present in the attempted batch path

confirmed_patterns.description: The model treated logs and status narration as if they were completion of the requested closure.
The model stopped after MarkItDown extraction and regression success instead of pursuing the missing postcondition.
Learning capture exists in the Telegram wrapper path, but the batch runner path bypasses it.
The model observed PENDING but did not convert that observation into a targeted fix or explicit blocker.
The model correctly preserved safety gates, but did not keep post-activation closure separate from safety success.

root_cause.pending_certification: task_master_registered() requires CERTIFIED; the ABS attempt stayed PENDING and skipped documents/Qdrant write
root_cause.missing_learning_entry: run_batch() calls run_docsreg_cycle() directly and does not invoke the Telegram wrapper _record_cycle_learning()

teaching_points: A report is not a completed fix.
Trace the owner of every required artifact.
Batch and Telegram execution paths are not interchangeable.
A PENDING gate must be explained by the exact gate that set it.
If a required learning file is absent, the path that should write it must be identified and repaired.
recommended_repair_rules: Do not declare success until the requested file exists.
Do not assume a downstream hook ran just because the main cycle finished.
Keep certification gates strict, but separately ensure learning capture runs on attempted cycles.
Always verify final artifacts on disk, not only in logs.
